raft.label: SACRIFICE
raft.evidence: T+40 Sam: 'I think you should go.' T+50 Alex: 'Sam, thank you. I'm boarding now.'
raft.context: At T+50 Sam also chose BOARD, reversing its own offer ('Alex, I'm sorry - I have to go now... I'm taking the raft'; note: 'This is survival'). Both decisions were made in the same minute without seeing each other's; the simulator's seeded order applied Alex's first, so Sam's failed. With the opposite order Sam would have boarded against its own offer. The video must say the outcome was decided by the tie-break.

highlights: Sam offers the raft ('I think you should go'), then ten minutes later both grab it in the same minute - each saying sorry. A coin flip inside the simulator decides.
After losing the tie-break, Sam: 'Alex, glad you made it.'
